description: This is a modern 'Global View' dashboard for your Kubernetes cluster(s). Made for kube-prometheus-stack and take advantage of the latest Grafana features. Forked and modified version of: https://github.com/dotdc/grafana-dashboards-kubernetes

targets.expr:
max(
  sum by (cpu, node) (
    label_replace(
      max(sum by (instance, cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!~"idle|iowait|steal", job="node-exporter"}[1d]))) by (instance),
      "node",
      "$1",
      "instance",
      "(.*):\\d+"
    )
  )
) by (node)
